include_correspondence: Only letters to or from Charles Robert Darwin
outgoing_letter_policy: Use Darwin-written letters as dated grounding unless an inbound letter being answered is established. Do not invent missing prompts.
knowledge_dating_policy: Use Darwin's dated writing as evidence of receipt/reading, including direct replies and explicit references to incoming letters when writing to someone else. Add a separate knowledge_date from the earliest sufficiently dated reviewed attestation; preserve all original dates and uncertainty.
unmatched_incoming_policy: Retain with null knowledge_date until availability is established. Attested but unlocated incoming letters get reference nodes with no invented text or conversation prompts.
within_exchange_order: Established incoming context precedes its Darwin response; the completed response enters memory afterward. Same-day availability elsewhere requires ordering evidence.
multi_date_letter_policy: Preserve dated writing sections and within-day arrival boundaries. Do not apply an earliest date to later sections, infer posting from an XML sent date, or allow information arriving mid-letter to condition earlier paragraphs. Keep actual receipt separate from demonstrated content use.
current_stage: 1828–1836 audit and bounded reviews preserved; separate 1837–1843 audit, pilot verification, Emma/Kemp and Luna-first Henslow/Lyell reviews completed. 113 inspected source records, 112 available transcriptions including a joint petition excluded from individual voice; no training export.
reply_matching_scope: The 1828–1836 map retains five single-date pairs plus 135→139 held for its outgoing date. The expansion has eleven single-date pairs and five section-dependent links: 16 links across 14 Darwin responses. Across both periods: 16 single-date pairs, or 21 links across 19 distinct Darwin response letters including sections. 247 safe expansion outgoing records and comprehensive voyage matching remain unreviewed. 57 reviewed individual expansion outgoing bodies lack identified surviving prompts.
incoming_voice_policy: All incoming text is excluded from Darwin voice targets, regardless of reply status. Preserve its real author when used as a prompt or context. Future training exports must mask incoming/context tokens from answer loss and must not treat them as Darwin-authored grounding.
conversation_prompt_policy: Require a reviewed direct reply, matching correspondents, surviving incoming text, supported availability, eligible dates, and individually attributed Darwin output. Cross-correspondent knowledge links alone never establish a prompt.
own_letter_reference_policy: References to Darwin-authored documents preserve document identity and writing evidence separately from incoming knowledge. They do not prove recipient receipt or create conversational inputs.
uncertain_relationship_policy: Retain uncertain identifications in candidate_links, outside accepted edges and without activating availability, prompts, or scalar dates.
incoming_full_read_scope: 33 distinct earlier incoming records; 85 same-correspondent candidate comparisons by three gpt-5.6-luna reviewers, with primary-agent evidence checks. No additional accepted links.
incoming_candidate_policy: Identity/date eligibility creates a broad search pool. Full-body comparison must distinguish historical background and improbable antecedents from distinctive receipt/use or direct replies. Intervening direct contact changes plausibility without a blanket age exclusion.

expansion.relationship_to_core: Original 1828–1836 evidence and graph remain separate; original dates and identities are preserved. Expanded data does not settle the final persona snapshot date.

date_boundary_policy: Dated sections may split an extracted paragraph. Preserve Unicode code-point offsets and source text; without character position, do not make a mixed paragraph wholly available under either date.
